title: Diwali Outfit Ideas for Women in the UK, USA and Canada
excerpt: Easy Diwali outfit ideas for women celebrating abroad – from office Diwali parties to family pujas, with tips on colours, fabrics and layering.
body:
Celebrating Diwali away from home is special. Whether it is a family puja, a community event or a Diwali party at the office, the right outfit makes it feel like home.

## For the family puja

Choose something traditional and comfortable for sitting on the floor and lighting diyas. A cotton kurta pant dupatta set in a festive colour – mint, mustard, rose or deep blue – is perfect. Hand block prints add a homely, Jaipur feel.

## For the office Diwali party

Many workplaces in the UK, USA and Canada now celebrate Diwali. A straight kurta set in a soft colour, worn with simple earrings, looks festive but still office-friendly. Skip the heavy dupatta if you are commuting – drape it only for photos.

## For the community Diwali night

This is the time to dress up. A flared Anarkali in taffeta silk with gota detailing feels celebratory and photographs well under lights and diyas.

## Colours that feel like Diwali

Gold, mustard, marigold orange, emerald, deep pink and royal blue are classic. Pastels like mint and lavender are a fresh, modern option.

## Staying warm without hiding your outfit

Diwali falls in autumn, so evenings can be cold abroad. Layer a fitted thermal underneath, carry a pashmina-style shawl, or wear a long coat over your outfit and take it off indoors.

## Plan ahead

Shipping from India takes time, so order your Diwali outfit early. For next year, aim to order by the end of September.
